firm_data.firm_description: Chopra & Nocerino is a New York personal injury law firm serving Long Island and the surrounding area. They are the exclusive personal injury law firm of the New York Mets, New York Islanders, Brooklyn Nets, UBS Arena & Barclays Center.

email.subject: AI for Chopra & Nocerino, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Sameer,

As the exclusive personal injury law firm for the New York Mets, Brooklyn Nets, and New York Islanders, you're handling high-stakes cases that demand precision and speed.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by Garden City to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
